messages:
alex_kaplan: opened PR to add Terraform module for GPU pool provisioning in eu-west. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/487 — changes include modules/gpu_pool.tf and networking/vpc-peering.tf. Need 2 infra approvals + SRE sign-off on SGs. can someone take a look? :eyes:

jamie_s: looking now. quick q — are we creating a new subnet or reusing the existing gpu-subnet? i see vpc-peering changes.

alex_kaplan: new subnet: gpu-subnet-2 in eu-west-1, CIDR 10.40.32.0/24. isolation from prod on purpose. snippet:
```hcl
resource "aws_subnet" "gpu" {
  cidr_block = "10.40.32.0/24"
  vpc_id     = module.vpc.id
}
```

maria_li: also need an IAM role for node provisioning — I don't see it in the module. if it's external, add a clear note in the PR and tfvars. please include an upgrade/migration strategy for existing pools.

infra-bot: CI report: terraform fmt OK. terraform validate FAILED on networking/vpc-peering.tf:
```
Error: provider "aws" requires an alias when configuring multiple regions
```

alex_kaplan: thanks infra-bot — will add provider alias and the IAM role. pushing fixes in ~30m.

timothy: i'll review after the push. also add a short migration plan to move running jobs off the old pool to avoid interruptions.

jamie_s: one more thing — do we need security group rules for model-serving instances? SRE should confirm allowed ingress ranges.

sre_oncall: jumping in — we prefer SGs that whitelist internal CIDRs only (no 0.0.0.0/0). use NAT for outbound external access. approve if SG restricts to 10.0.0.0/8 + peered VPC ranges.

alex_kaplan: @sre_oncall thanks, i'll add the SG rule and update the PR description. tagging @timothy @maria_li for re-review once i push.

timothy: :thumbsup: will take another pass, aim to approve if migration plan and SG changes are present.

alex_kaplan: pushed fixes: provider aliases, IAM role, migration section, and SG rules. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/487

timothy: LGTM, left a tiny nit about variable naming (gpu_pool_count -> gpu_pool_size). approving once that's addressed.

maria_li: approved after the nit fix. :rocket:

alex_kaplan: thanks everyone! will merge in ~15m after CI is green and post a short runbook in #eng-infra. /cc @oncall
